receipts.headers:
/*
  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
  Permissions-Policy: camera=(), geolocation=(), microphone=(), payment=()
  X-Frame-Options: DENY

/_astro/*
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable

/fonts/*
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable

/brand/*
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400

# BEGIN JM GUIDE ROUTE
/guia-de-leitura/*
  ! X-Frame-Options
  Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://jm-guia-leitura-stock.joao-maria-editora.workers.dev; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors https://catalogo.joaoemariaeditora.com.br https://www.joaoemariaeditora.com.br https://joaoemariaeditora.com.br http://127.0.0.1:4380; form-action 'self'
  X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow
# END JM GUIDE ROUTE

# BEGIN JM INFLUENCER PAGES
/combo-da-cassia-kawamura/*
  X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow
/combo-da-forja-diaria/*
  X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow
/influenciadoras-assets/*
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable
# END JM INFLUENCER PAGES
